about: Gold evidence for judge-eval: for each of the 21 opposite pairs and one clear same pair per question, the sentences of the against answer that contradict the claim or say the same, picked by hand from the claim, the whole against answer and the pair's reason and note.
text: Each evidence entry is one sentence, list item or table row of the against answer, copied as the answer shows it: list markers, ** and __, backticks and inline links left out (a link keeps its text), table cells joined by ' | '. Best first, 1 to 3 entries. judge-eval maps each entry to units of the against answer when it loads (one unit, a run of consecutive units, or inside one unit) and records every entry it cannot map.
same: one same pair per question: among the question's pairs with label same in the clear group, the one whose id has the smallest SHA-256 (lower-case hex of the UTF-8 id)
